## A well-documented machine that nobody has written down how to build

TODO — the distinction this book depends on. Hammack, Kranz and Carpenter's
2014 book and the engineerguy series document the analyzer thoroughly: what each
mechanism does, how the maths maps onto the metal, and what it looks like from
eight angles. They are not the gap. The gap is that no dimensioned drawing, no
tolerance, no stock list and no setup sheet has ever been published for it.
